# Helping *Hometown* **Grocers**
# Across America Thrive

For more than 107 years, we’ve helped hometown grocers — from national chains to single-store
operators — serve their communities. Through innovative supply chain solutions, quality products and
services, and trusted retail experiences, we help keep shelves stocked and families fed across the
country.

## Our Stores & Services

[ View All Services ][79]

### Financial Services

Discover how our comprehensive financial services, including payroll, accounts payable, tax
consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

[ About Financial Services ][80]

### Food Safety Services

As a food solutions company that has earned consumer trust for more than 107 years, C&S understands
the importance of having rigorous standards and training for food safety.

[ About Food Safety Services ][81]

### Marketing Services

C&S offers marketing support to elevate your brand, including cutting-edge technology and
industry-leading insights — all designed to enhance your promotional strategies, from digital
advertising to community engagement.

[ About Marketing Services ][82]

### Pharmacy Solutions

Our pharmacy services leverage collective buying power across 2,500 independent pharmacies to
guarantee lower operational costs for you and better health outcomes for the community you serve. 

[ About Pharmacy Solutions ][83]

### Our Stores

The C&S family of companies includes more than 200 grocery stores in 12 states, in addition to
dozens of pharmacies and fuel centers with convenience stores.

[ About Our Stores ][84]

### OurBrands

OurBrands are carried in company-operated stores and are distributed to our independent retail
customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

[ About OurBrands ][85]

## Our Impact

## Committed to Communities Beyond the Store

At C&S Wholesale Grocers, the families we serve are at the core of everything we do, from combating
hunger to safeguarding the environment. We collaborate with organizations nationwide to make a
lasting impact on the communities where we live and work.

## A Trusted Leader
## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

## Careers

Find the right job

PFG is a great place to start and build a career. We hire in a variety of fields.

** Drivers
** Warehouse
** Sales
** Finance
** Supply Chain
** Marketing
** Human Resources
** Information Technology
** Procurement

[Search For Jobs ][25]

### Delivering Success With A Focus On Innovation

We find flexible, efficient solutions for our customers


Everything we do is built around ensuring our customers’ businesses thrive. We started delivering
food in 1885 and over the years have re-invented ourselves time and again to stay ahead of the
industry. That’s why our customers don’t just see us as order takers; they see us as success
makers.

manufacturer and supplier of  all kinds of Bakery & Savoury Products. Since we started the company,

in research and development to continuously innovate and improve our product offerings to match the
ever-evolving consumer preferences and trends within the industry.

* We provide our products at very reasonable prices aiming to ensure value for money for our
  customers.

**Production of Quality Products**

Bikaner Namkeen Wala Food Products is a company that produces premium bakery and savory goods. The
company produces a wide variety of snacks by fusing traditional recipes with contemporary
manufacturing methods. Bikaner Namkeen Wala is renowned for its dedication to flavor and freshness,
and it makes sure that all of its goods adhere to strict quality standards. Focusing on preserving
genuine flavors, the company serves a wide range of clients by providing both traditional Indian
snacks and creative baked goods. The company is committed to keeping up with the latest trends and
growing its line of products.

What started as a family kitchen in a small Pennsylvania town became one of America's most loved

Where It All Started

### Born in Mountville, Pennsylvania

In 1942, the Musser family started cooking potato chips in small batches and delivering them
door-to-door in the now-iconic gold tin. What began as a local tradition quickly became an American
institution — one tin at a time.

The Truck on Your Street

### Delivered to Your Door. For Real.

Before online shopping existed, Charles Chips was already showing up at your doorstep. The gold tin,
the delivery truck, the knock on the door — ask your parents. They remember.

institution — one tin at a time.

## Welcome to Contest Distribution

### A worldwide proven wholesale distributor company of confectionery, chips, gums, candies, coffee,

We warehouse a vast selection of fast-moving consumer goods and ship wholesale and bulk to more than
90 countries, in [Central Europe][101], [Eastern Europe][102] and [Western Europe][103] including

[China][123], [Hongkong][124], and [Spain][125].

And because customer experience is what we value the most, we offer not only distribution and
wholesale but also [logistics][126] and [labeling services][127]. Our highly experienced and
energetic team will support you through the whole purchasing process and will make sure you always
get the best pricing and delivery terms. Do not hesitate, but contact us now, because we have more
than 2500 genuine products from famous brands in stock and ready to ship.

Contest Distribution has already operated in the confectionery market for more than 10 years. We
know how important it is for our wholesale and bulk clients to get their[ sweet and chocolate
products][128] at the best price. However, we know well that competitive prices are as important as
customer service. Our team will provide you with personal support and answer all the questions you
have about confectionary wholesale. We offer 100% [genuine products][129] of the following sweets
and chocolate world-known brands:

We supply resellers and retailers all over the world with some of the most famous chips products.
And we brag to be rewarded with excellent feedback on the quality of work and the fast delivery
terms. If you are looking for a chips products distribution company, do not hesitate, to send us an

### **Gums and Candy Wholesale Distribution**

If you are looking for a [candy import company online][149], we are here to help. Contest

you with a fast and pleasant purchasing process. We ship to more than 90 countries worldwide.
Moreover, we are already proven as trusted [jellybeans and chewing gums][150] supplier to many

Contest Distribution is proud to be a [Red Bull][156], Monster and [Hell Energy drinks
distributor][157] and in case you are looking for an [energy drinks importer][158], we will be more
than happy to deliver to you. 

### **Coffee Distribution and Wholesale**

Tea and coffee are the main points in our beverage distribution list of world-known products with
proven quality. If you are looking for a [coffee or tea import company][159] to contact, the Contest

# Excellent Service. Fast delivery.

## Welcome to Contest Distribution

### A worldwide proven wholesale distributor company of confectionery, chips, gums, candies, coffee,
### tea, energy drinks, beauty, and home care products

We warehouse a vast selection of fast-moving consumer goods and ship wholesale and bulk to more than
90 countries, in [Central Europe][101], [Eastern Europe][102] and [Western Europe][103] including
Belgium, Brazil, Canada, [Cyprus][104], Dubai, England, [France][105], [Greece][106], Hong Kong,
[Japan][107], Hungary, [Poland][108], Italy, [Israel][109], [Palestine][110], [Jordan][111],
[Libya][112], [Lebanon][113], Malta, [Nigeria][114], [India][115], [Morocco][116], [Egypt][117], 
[The Netherlands][118], Portugal, [Ukraine][119], [Russia][120], [UAE][121], [Saudi Arabia][122],
[China][123], [Hongkong][124], and [Spain][125].

And because customer experience is what we value the most, we offer not only distribution and
wholesale but also [logistics][126] and [labeling services][127]. Our highly experienced and
energetic team will support you through the whole purchasing process and will make sure you always
get the best pricing and delivery terms. Do not hesitate, but contact us now, because we have more
than 2500 genuine products from famous brands in stock and ready to ship.  

### **Confectionery Distribution and Wholesale**

Contest Distribution has already operated in the confectionery market for more than 10 years. We
know how important it is for our wholesale and bulk clients to get their[ sweet and chocolate
products][128] at the best price. However, we know well that competitive prices are as important as
customer service. Our team will provide you with personal support and answer all the questions you
have about confectionary wholesale. We offer 100% [genuine products][129] of the following sweets
and chocolate world-known brands:
* [Corny][130]
* [Lindt][131] - we are  Lindt Chocolates official distributor
* [Mars][132]
* [Storck][133]
* [Ferrero][134] - we are  Ferrero official distributor
* [Mondelez][135]
* [Nestle][136]
* [7 days][137]
* [Ritter Sport][138]
* [Gullon][139]
* [Wrigley][140]
* [Zaini][141]
* [Ariel][142]
* [Lenor][143]

### **Chips Products International Wholesale**

[Potato chips distribution][144] is one of Contest Distribution’s strongest wholesale departments.
We supply resellers and retailers all over the world with some of the most famous chips products.
And we brag to be rewarded with excellent feedback on the quality of work and the fast delivery
terms. If you are looking for a chips products distribution company, do not hesitate, to send us an
inquiry for any of the following potato chips and snacks brands:
* [Pringles][145]
* [Lay's][146]
* [Ruffles][147]
* Star Snacks
* [Doritos][148]

### **Gums and Candy Wholesale Distribution**

If you are looking for a [candy import company online][149], we are here to help. Contest
Distribution is a gums and candies wholesale distribution company with enough experience to provide
you with a fast and pleasant purchasing process. We ship to more than 90 countries worldwide.
Moreover, we are already proven as trusted [jellybeans and chewing gums][150] supplier to many
re-sellers and chain stores. [Contact us][151] now and get a quote for gums and candy wholesale of
the most famous brands distribution, including:
* [Mondelez][152]  - we are  Mondelez official distributor
* [Trolli][153]
* [Mentos][154]
* PEZ
* [Wrigley][155]

### **Energy Drinks Distribution**

Contest Distribution is proud to be a [Red Bull][156], Monster and [Hell Energy drinks
distributor][157] and in case you are looking for an [energy drinks importer][158], we will be more
than happy to deliver to you. 

### **Coffee Distribution and Wholesale**

Tea and coffee are the main points in our beverage distribution list of world-known products with
proven quality. If you are looking for a [coffee or tea import company][159] to contact, the Contest
Distribution team will be happy to answer all your questions and provide you with the best service.
The coffee brands we wholesale and ship the most are:
* [Illy][160]
* [Lavazza][161]
* [Davidoff][162]

### **Beauty and home care products distribution**

Contest Distribution has already expanded the list of FMCG products to offer and we already
distribute [detergents ][163]for beauty and home care. Here is a list of some of the most widely
sold brands, that we have in stock and are ready for distribution:  
* Colgate
* Palmolive

## MACHINE CONFIGURATION

●  Stainless steel machine cover and food grade contact parts
 
●  Centralized control for the whole line, easy to operate

●  Siemens motor

●  Siemens PLC and touch screen

●  ODM and OEM service provided to meet client’s diverse request
 

## ABOUT DARIN

As Member of APPA and Deputy President Unit of SDPIA, Darin is established in 2011, and is a
High-Tech Enterprise of Shandong Province, specializing in development and sales of pet food
machine, puff snack machine, energy granola bar machine and support equipment. Now Darin machines
have been exported to more than 100 countries of the world. Keeping automation, quality and service
in mind, always based on the diverse needs of customers, Darin will be dedicated to providing
clients with satified product and full life after sales service.

engineers available to service machines oveaseas; English operation manual, operation video, autoCAD
will be provided for installation; Full life after sales service is provided.

## ABOUT DARIN

As Member of APPA and Deputy President Unit of SDPIA, Darin is established in 2011, and is a
High-Tech Enterprise of Shandong Province, specializing in development and sales of pet food
machine, puff snack machine, energy granola bar machine and support equipment. Now Darin machines
have been exported to more than 100 countries of the world. Keeping automation, quality and service
in mind, always based on the diverse needs of customers, Darin will be dedicated to providing
clients with satified product and full life after sales service.

better acts, and the weather no longer dictates whether or not the show can go on.

continues to evolve, one goal remains consistent: creating spaces that feel welcoming, modern, and
worthy of the Champions Run name. That was the goal with the construction of the business's new
indoor pickleball facility. Utilized as a finish material on the building's exterior were precast
concrete panels from Quick Veneer.

headquartered in Portland, OR, specified 102,360 square feet of the material for the exterior walls.

Posted: Jun 15, 2026

### EAA Chapter 25 Hangar

[][65]

When Patrick Halligan, a board member for Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA) Chapter 25,
approached Schweiss Doors owner Mike Schweiss about a good deal on a hangar door, Schweiss stepped
up. The chapter was in the process of raising funds for a new hangar and any savings would be
helpful. What Halligan did not expect was for Schweiss to donate what ended up being a bifold door,
measuring 54 feet wide by 16 feet tall.

Posted: Jun 08, 2026

### Cornhusker Express Lube

[][67]

For automotive service companies, success depends on speed, efficiency, and creating a professional
appearance that customers recognize and trust. For businesses like Cornhusker Express Lube—where
quick-turn oil changes and reliable auto repair are the foundation of daily operations—the building
itself plays a major role in supporting that mission. It's construction mirrors the same traits of
speed and efficiency, especially when it comes to the attractive brick base that surrounds the
building shell. It was created using brick-patterned precast concrete panels from Wahoo, NE-based

better acts, and the weather no longer dictates whether or not the show can go on.

concrete panels from Quick Veneer.

Posted: Jun 22, 2026

### City of Bend Public Works Campus

[][63]

With the aim of consolidating five public works departments into one campus, the City of Bend,
Oregon, wanted a facility that would serve long-term growth while being designed with resiliency,
well-being and energy efficiency. The material that helped pull the City of Bend Public Works Campus
project together was A606 Weathering Steel from The Bryer Company. Hennebery Eddy Architects,
headquartered in Portland, OR, specified 102,360 square feet of the material for the exterior walls.

[Read][64]

Posted: Jun 15, 2026

### EAA Chapter 25 Hangar

[][65]

When Patrick Halligan, a board member for Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA) Chapter 25,
approached Schweiss Doors owner Mike Schweiss about a good deal on a hangar door, Schweiss stepped
up. The chapter was in the process of raising funds for a new hangar and any savings would be
helpful. What Halligan did not expect was for Schweiss to donate what ended up being a bifold door,
measuring 54 feet wide by 16 feet tall.

[Read][66]

Posted: Jun 08, 2026

### Cornhusker Express Lube

[][67]

For automotive service companies, success depends on speed, efficiency, and creating a professional
appearance that customers recognize and trust. For businesses like Cornhusker Express Lube—where
quick-turn oil changes and reliable auto repair are the foundation of daily operations—the building
itself plays a major role in supporting that mission. It's construction mirrors the same traits of
speed and efficiency, especially when it comes to the attractive brick base that surrounds the
building shell. It was created using brick-patterned precast concrete panels from Wahoo, NE-based
Quick Veneer.

About Us

## About Us

Zhaoqing Fengxiang Food Machinery Co., Ltd. is a decade old company designing performance-friendly
and easy-to-operate Machinery for the food & beverage industries. We have emerged as an eminent
manufacturer, exporter, trader and supplier of Cabbage Dicing & Washing Production Line, Fish
Processing Machine Series, Vegetable Washing Machine, Potato Chips Cutter, Frozen French Fries
Processing Line, Garlic/Shallot Machine Series, Meat Processing Machine Series and more since
inception in 2006. All these are engineered and designed precisely to perfection using matchless
metal alloys and state-of-the-art technologies. Being dedicated towards client satisfaction, we only
deliver quality beyond customers expectations. For that, a team of experienced quality evaluators
underline strict norms and standards of the industry and confirm only those machines for deliveries
that encompass smooth operations, easy handling, less maintenance and higher productivity. Further,
we price all our machinery at minimal possible rates to win large clientele and retain them on the
basis of timely deliveries, transparent dealings and improvised solutions.

Crisp combines the power of agentic AI with deep retail expertise to help you leverage your data to
drive outcomes. Use Crisp AI to manage and enrich your data and uncover mission-critical insights
with a business language conversation. Crisp AI is designed to automate actions that optimize
merchandising and maximize supply chain performance.

###### Agent Services & Applications

## Applications and analytics that enhance retail performance

Crisp analyzes daily data across every store and SKU to help you manage your supply chain every
single day.

Sales & Supply Chain Managment

Leverage daily, SKU- and store-level intelligence to understand performance, optimize retail
execution, and keep products selling at your target velocity.

# Golden Flake Chips Manufacturer

Golden Flake brings the bold taste of the South straight to your snack bowl. Born in Birmingham in
1928, this iconic brand has turned crispy chips and zesty pork skins into a regional legend. From
Sweet Heat Barbecue to Old Fashioned Pork Rinds, every bite delivers that unmistakable Southern
crunch that’s been loved for generations. Golden Flake—where classic flavor meets true Southern
pride.

[ Learn More ][4]

## Top Golden Flake Chips

### Golden Flake Sweet Heat Barbecue Potato Chips

A Southern classic with a fiery twist—these chips blend smoky barbecue flavor with just the right
touch of sweetness and heat for an unforgettable crunch.

[ Check Price ][5]

### Golden Flake Old Fashioned Pork Skins

Light, crispy, and perfectly seasoned, these traditional pork skins deliver that authentic Southern
bite that’s been loved for generations.

[ Check Price ][6]

### Golden Flake Cheese Curls

Boldly cheesy and irresistibly airy, these golden curls melt in your mouth and keep snack lovers
coming back for more with every handful.

[ Check Price ][7]

Golden Flake turns everyday snacking into a taste of the South—crispy, bold, and full of flavor
rooted in nearly a century of tradition.


## Product Categories

### Potato Chips

Crispy, golden, and bursting with Southern charm, Golden Flake potato chips come in irresistible
flavors like Sweet Heat Barbecue, Dill Pickle, and Original—each one a crunchy reminder of why
they’ve been a regional favorite for decades.

### Cheese Snacks

Cheese lovers rejoice—Golden Flake Cheese Curls, Puffs, and Rings deliver that melt-in-your-mouth
texture and bold, cheesy kick that keeps hands diving back into the bag.

### Corn-Based Snacks

From buttery puff corn to nacho cheese tortilla chips, these corn-based classics offer light, airy
crunch with rich, savory flavor perfect for parties or everyday munching.

### Pork Skins and Cracklins

Golden Flake pork skins and cracklins bring authentic Southern snack heritage to life with flavors
like Louisiana Hot Sauce, Red Pepper, and Sweet Heat—each crackle packed with satisfying crunch and
spice.

### Specialty Snacks and Variety Packs

Snack mixes, pretzels, nuts, and peanut butter crackers add variety for every craving, conveniently
packaged for on-the-go flavor that keeps the South snacking proud.

## Reviews

**James Hollister**
“I grew up in Alabama, and Golden Flake chips were always part of every family picnic and tailgate.
The Sweet Heat Barbecue flavor hits that perfect balance of spice and sweetness, reminding me of
backyard cookouts and football weekends. Even after moving to Tennessee, I still order them online
because nothing else compares to that Southern crunch.”

**Melissa Turner**
“As a lifelong fan of pork rinds, I can confidently say Golden Flake nails it every single time. The
Red Pepper flavor has just the right amount of heat without being overpowering. I love pairing them
with a cold drink on game nights—they’re crisp, flavorful, and totally addictive. You can tell
they’ve perfected their craft over generations.”

**David Ramirez**
“The Cheese Puffs from Golden Flake are my go-to snack during long drives. They’re airy, perfectly
seasoned, and don’t leave that heavy, greasy feeling some snacks do. I also appreciate that the
brand has stayed true to its Southern roots while expanding its reach—every bite tastes nostalgic
yet fresh.”

## Golden Flake FAQ

### What flavors of Golden Flake potato chips are available?

Golden Flake offers a variety of flavors, including Sweet Heat Barbecue, Original, Hot, Dill Pickle,
Mesquite Barbecue, Cheddar & Sour Cream, and Vinegar & Salt.

### Where can I buy Golden Flake snacks?

Golden Flake products are primarily available in the Southern United States through grocery stores,
major retailers, and online platforms such as Utz Snacks, Instacart, and Stewart Snacks.

### Are Golden Flake snacks gluten-free?

Some Golden Flake products, like certain potato chips and pork skins, are naturally gluten-free, but
it’s best to check the packaging or product description for each item to be sure.

### Does Golden Flake offer variety packs or snack mixes?

Yes, Golden Flake provides specialty and variety packs, including mixed chips, snack-size packs, and
combinations of pork skins, cheese curls, and other popular snacks.

### Who owns Golden Flake?

Golden Flake Snack Foods is a subsidiary of Utz Brands, which has managed the brand’s operations and
distribution since 2016.

### Can I contact Golden Flake directly for inquiries?

Yes, you can reach Golden Flake Snack Foods at (205) 323-6161 or visit their main address at 1
Golden Flake Drive, Birmingham, Alabama, 35205, USA.

### Are Golden Flake products suitable for parties and large gatherings?

Absolutely—many of their chips, pork skins, and snack mixes are available in sharing sizes or
variety packs, making them ideal for entertaining.

seasoned, and don’t leave that heavy, greasy feeling some snacks do. I also appreciate that the
brand has stayed true to its Southern roots while expanding its reach—every bite tastes nostalgic
yet fresh.”

## Golden Flake FAQ

### What flavors of Golden Flake potato chips are available?

Golden Flake offers a variety of flavors, including Sweet Heat Barbecue, Original, Hot, Dill Pickle,
Mesquite Barbecue, Cheddar & Sour Cream, and Vinegar & Salt.

### Where can I buy Golden Flake snacks?

Golden Flake products are primarily available in the Southern United States through grocery stores,
major retailers, and online platforms such as Utz Snacks, Instacart, and Stewart Snacks.

### Are Golden Flake snacks gluten-free?

Some Golden Flake products, like certain potato chips and pork skins, are naturally gluten-free, but
it’s best to check the packaging or product description for each item to be sure.

### Does Golden Flake offer variety packs or snack mixes?

Yes, Golden Flake provides specialty and variety packs, including mixed chips, snack-size packs, and
combinations of pork skins, cheese curls, and other popular snacks.

### Who owns Golden Flake?

Golden Flake Snack Foods is a subsidiary of Utz Brands, which has managed the brand’s operations and
distribution since 2016.

### Can I contact Golden Flake directly for inquiries?

Yes, you can reach Golden Flake Snack Foods at (205) 323-6161 or visit their main address at 1
Golden Flake Drive, Birmingham, Alabama, 35205, USA.

### Are Golden Flake products suitable for parties and large gatherings?

Absolutely—many of their chips, pork skins, and snack mixes are available in sharing sizes or
variety packs, making them ideal for entertaining.

# Our History

Martin’s Potato Chips is located in south central Pennsylvania which is considered by many to be the

# Our History

Martin’s Potato Chips is located in south central Pennsylvania which is considered by many to be the
snack food capital of the world. From the farm kitchen of Harry and Fairy Martin, back in 1941, a
unique potato chip found its way into the hearts and homes of York County. Their business soon
outgrew the kitchen. The Martin’s built a small factory and expanded their distribution from
delivering fresh daily to market stands, to also selling to mom and pop grocery stores.

Mira decodes product labels and gives you a clear read on food and cosmetics — instantly, from a

Independence

## A 100% independent project

No trade-offs between your health and someone's profit. Mira depends on no brand, and our scores
answer only to you.

### No brand influence

No brand or manufacturer can influence the scores or recommendations shown in the app.

### No advertising

Brands cannot pay Mira to promote their products inside the app.

### Responsible funding

Three transparent funding sources rule out any conflict of interest that could compromise the
objectivity of our analysis.

[Learn more][10]

Mira gives you a guide, not a verdict. It does not guarantee better health. Its rating method is
independent — inspired by scientific studies and, for nutrition, the Nutri-Score method — but not
approved by any health authority.

Food

## Rate the quality of your food

Do you really know what you're buying? Mira scans and analyses labels in the blink of an eye — so
you can tell at a glance what stands out and what's worth a closer look.

## KEY PEOPLE

[Mr. Ajit Mota Founder]

### Mr. Ajit Mota Founder

An ardent food lover himself, Mota Chips is his dream of spreading this labour of love. His will to
serve all food-loving people with exotic snacks laid the foundation of Mota Chips on the 5th of May,
1992.

[Mrs. Amrut Mota]

### Mrs. Amrut Mota

The backbone of this venture, Mrs. Amrut Mota, stood by Mr. Ajit Mota as his pillar of strength. Her
unflinching support and a passion for food, is what drove her husband to follow his dreams.

[Mr. Jeegar Mota & Mr. Dilip Mota]

### Mr. Jeegar Mota & Mr. Dilip Mota

With their dynamic new-age ideas, Jeegar and Dilip Mota have further taken this dream to new
heights. Their foresight and innovation has turned Mota Chips into one of the leading manufacturers
of potato chips and other delectable savouries.

1992.

[Mrs. Amrut Mota]

### Mrs. Amrut Mota

The backbone of this venture, Mrs. Amrut Mota, stood by Mr. Ajit Mota as his pillar of strength. Her
unflinching support and a passion for food, is what drove her husband to follow his dreams.

[Mr. Jeegar Mota & Mr. Dilip Mota]

### Mr. Jeegar Mota & Mr. Dilip Mota

With their dynamic new-age ideas, Jeegar and Dilip Mota have further taken this dream to new
heights. Their foresight and innovation has turned Mota Chips into one of the leading manufacturers
of potato chips and other delectable savouries.

## Why Us?

Our business plan consultants combine financial modeling, market research, and funding strategy to
create SBA-compliant and investor-ready business plans
* 1
  
  #### Results-oriented solution
  
  Our professional business planning consultants will highlight the viability and attractiveness of
  your innovative idea. Our team will prepare a document with a sellable story as its core that will
  help you generate investor interest and exceed their expectations.
* 2
  
  #### Best practices/guidance
  
  Our consultants bring best practices to your business. We will conduct detailed market research,
  prepare a detailed road map of the business development and a complete picture of the financial
  and, finally, we will provide strategic advice that will help you to become a market leader and
  build a highly sellable company.
* 3
  [icon_Strategic]
  
  #### Strategic Advice
  
  All our senior business plan consultants are MBA fellows with 15+ years’ experience in 45
  industries, working in the leading investment banks, consulting companies (Deloitte, Bain, PWC)
  and serving Fortune 1000 companies. Our experience and expertise will help you better position
  your business.
* 4
  
  #### High-quality market research
  
  Our documents include market analysis prepared globally recognized research firms including
  IBISworld, Datamonitor, MarketLine, Statista, etc.
* 5
  
  #### Full Customization
  
  OGScapital approaches each case from scratch. We make our approach suit your particular needs —
  not the other way around. Each document is unique — no templates and no ready-made solutions. All
  of our user-friendly presentations include full-color graphs, tables, charts, and illustrations.
* 6
  [Fundraising]
  
  #### Funding
  
  OGScapital gives you access to an established and broad network of investors and other crucial
  contacts.

Control of temperatures during f… [READ MORE][142] [cca26bd7-8eb3-47ef-9570-c35b2924cc5c] #### [Beyond Sunflower Oil: A Technical Guide For Artisan Chip Producers][143] 23rd June 2026 Frying oil selection determines oxidation rate, finished product shelf life, flavor stability, fryer cleaning frequency, filtration load, acrylamid… [READ MORE][144] ## AGRO UPDATES [Young,Blonde,Woman,Scientist,Holding,Sample,Of,Potato,With,Tweezers] #### [Hutton Launches Potato Virus Testing Service After SASA Withdrawal][145] 21st July 2026 Hutton Scientific Services has launched a commercial potato virus testing service for the 2026 seed campaign, moving to fill a gap created by the w… [READ MORE][146] [Olivet,,France,-,15,Mars,2021,:,Crop,Irrigation,System] #### [UK Potato Sector Calls for Water to Be Treated as Strategic Infrastructure][147] 21st July 2026 Britain’s potato industry has called for water supplies for agriculture to be treated as strategic national infrastructure, warning that unreliab… [READ MORE][148] ## STORAGE SPECIAL [[storage_n]][149] #### [New Field-Based Strategies Help Reduce Storage Losses From Black Dot In Potatoes][150] 14th April 2026 A decade-long research effort led by Phillip Wharton at the University of Idaho is providing potato growers with updated management strategies to a… [READ MORE][151] [[Potatoes_Storage_n]][152] #### [San Luis Valley Study Highlights New Dry Rot Threats For Potato Storage][153] 10th March 2026 A new study published in the journal Plant Disease has identified several Fusarium species responsible for potato dry rot in Colorado’s San Luis … [READ MORE][154] [[The non-renewal of CIPC in the European market has left a huge gap in the potato storage spout suppression market, so growers must start looking for alternatives for their potato crops. One option comes from, Restrain, the residue-free, ethylene gas company. Being aware of the potential for CIPC’s non-renewal, Restrain made significant investments in the business, enabling the company to increase its manufacturing capacity at its production facility in the Netherlands and therefore ensuring it has the capacity needed to fill the gap left by CIPC. Restrain’s generators have been used for potato storage for over 14 years and are fitted with sensors which maintain a stable, low-level of ethylene, which is vital for the safe storage of potatoes. The generator has 20 liter fuel capacity, so daily filling is not required unlike other catalytic generators and Restrain generators use a unique start-up mechanism that ensures the best possible outcome when storing potatoes. “Through our determination to create a world-class product we completely re-designed our machines, taking the manufacturing in house to improve machine quality and investing heavily in the development of our sensor technology. This means our new B100 and B200 generators require limited annual maintenance and are fully calibrated before leaving our site, making them ready to use straight away,” said Dirk Garos, global sales director at Restrain. Following a series of a successful variety of trails, Restrain technology has recently been adopted by the global potato processing sector. The sector, which has traditionally used CIPC and other storage chemicals, has seen a global trend towards more sustainable, chemical-free solutions, so Restrain meets these requirements and just at the right time. “Seeing that the processing sector might need alternative solutions to CIPC, we invested in multiple processing variety trails to ensure that we have robust data for processing customers. Our results show that fry colors are preserved, there is no need for a delay between storage and processing and the potatoes are completely residue-free,” explained Garos. Most importantly, Restrain is priced in line with CIPC, making it one of the most cost-effective alternatives available. One option comes from, Restrain, the residue-free, ethylene gas company. Being aware of the potential for CIPC’s non-renewal, Restrain made significant investments in the business, enabling the company to increase its manufacturing capacity at its production facility in the Netherlands and therefore ensuring it has the capacity needed to fill the gap left by CIPC. Restrain’s generators have been used for potato storage for over 14 years and are fitted with sensors which maintain a stable, low-level of ethylene, which is vital for the safe storage of potatoes. The generator has 20 liter fuel capacity, so daily filling is not required unlike other catalytic generators and Restrain generators use a unique start-up mechanism that ensures the best possible outcome when storing potatoes. “Through our determination to create a world-class product we completely re-designed our machines, taking the manufacturing in house to improve machine quality and investing heavily in the development of our sensor technology. This means our new B100 and B200 generators require limited annual maintenance and are fully calibrated before leaving our site, making them ready to use straight away,” said Dirk Garos, global sales director at Restrain. Following a series of a successful variety of trails, Restrain technology has recently been adopted by the global potato processing sector. The sector, which has traditionally used CIPC and other storage chemicals, has seen a global trend towards more sustainable, chemical-free solutions, so Restrain meets these requirements and just at the right time. “Seeing that the processing sector might need alternative solutions to CIPC, we invested in multiple processing variety trails to ensure that we have robust data for processing customers. Our results show that fry colors are preserved, there is no need for a delay between storage and processing and the potatoes are completely residue-free,” explained Garos. Most importantly, Restrain is priced in line with CIPC, making it one of the most cost-effective alternatives available. injurious bacteria and keep original flavor in food. Further the blanched potato chips have fresh
color and vegetable scent while active enzyme is controlled for easy reservation.

and the strips processes by this dewatering machine can be fried easily. The **[Potato Chips

by coal. The customers can choose anyone according to your energy resource. As it is known that the

chips and french fries have attractive luster and flavor.

centrifugal principle to get rid of extra oil from fried potato chips and french fries. Eating too

production cost.

type potato chips seasoning machine is very popular while for large potato chips production, the
disc type has more output.

the blanching machine and the fryer in the semi-automatic potato chip production line can use the
same equipment, as well as the dehydrator and deoiler, which can save a part of the investment cost
and is more suitable for small and medium food processing plants with low investment budget.

## Useful tips you should know

## 01.

### Fully automatic frozen fries processing craft

For industrial production of frozen french fries automatically, the producer should set an entire
fries plant with a series of french fries making machines which include washing and peeling machine,
slicer machine, blanching machine, frying machine, de-watering and de-oiling machine, quick freezer,
packaging machine and auxiliary equipment.

## 02.

### semi-automatic french fries production line

Based on the full-automatic frozen fries line, the semi-automatic french fries production line will
be more flexible with labor working. Due to less investment costs, this semi-automatic fries line is
very suitable for investors and small food processing plants in the early days of business.

## 03.

### fully automatic potato chips processing line

The processing technology of potato chips and fries is very similar, but there are some different
processing steps. For example, when making potato chips, we use a potato cutter to slice the
potatoes evenly (2mm). You can also use different cutters to make wavy potato chips. In addition,
after the potato chips are fried, we can use an automatic seasoning machine to season the potato
chips. The operation of the automatic potato chip production line is very intelligent, which can
save a lot of labor costs and high production efficiency.

## 04.

### semi-automatic potato chip making

The semi-automatic potato chip processing line eliminates a lot of automatic conveying equipment.And
the blanching machine and the fryer in the semi-automatic potato chip production line can use the
same equipment, as well as the dehydrator and deoiler, which can save a part of the investment cost
and is more suitable for small and medium food processing plants with low investment budget.

## 05.

### Fried banana chips production line knowledge

The fried banana chip production line also has automatic and semi-automatic production equipment.
The processing capacities of the production line can be matched with different equipment according
to customer needs. The production process of fried banana chips mainly includes peeling, slicing,
frying, de-oiling, seasoning and packaging.

distributors, wholesalers, and organized retail networks. Founded in 2009 by Mr. Rajesh Garg, a

supply, positioning itself as a dependable B2B snack manufacturing partner focused on consistent
growth and supply.

## Company Overview

As one of the largest manufacturers of potato chips in China, our company was founded as a joint
venture in 2004, with a registered capital of over 7.3 million US Dollars and a factory area of 51,
000 square meters. We're located in Yiyuan Economic Development Zone, which is about 2 hours drive
from Qingdao Port, the eighth largest port in the world.Our main products are compound potato chips,
sliced potato chips, as well as purple sweet potato chips, which include more than 100 varieties for
customers' selection, with a production capacity of 6, 000 tons annually.We sell our private-brand
products in China, as well as offer OEM service for customers throughout the world, such as Auchan,
TESCO, Dia%, RT-MART, AEON, LOTTE Mart, SPAR, Uni-Mart, covering East Asia, South East Asia, Middle
East, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and other regions.To achieve high production and management
standards, we have obtained the certification of ISO22000 (including HACCP) in 2008, Halal
certification in 2009, and BRC(British Retail Consortium) certification in 2013, as well as passed
Export Commodity Inspection in 2009.

## Company Overview

As one of the largest manufacturers of potato chips in China, our company was founded as a joint
venture in 2004, with a registered capital of over 7.3 million US Dollars and a factory area of 51,
000 square meters. We're located in Yiyuan Economic Development Zone, which is about 2 hours drive
from Qingdao Port, the eighth largest port in the world.Our main products are compound potato chips,
sliced potato chips, as well as purple sweet potato chips, which include more than 100 varieties for
customers' selection, with a production capacity of 6, 000 tons annually.We sell our private-brand
products in China, as well as offer OEM service for customers throughout the world, such as Auchan,
TESCO, Dia%, RT-MART, AEON, LOTTE Mart, SPAR, Uni-Mart, covering East Asia, South East Asia, Middle
East, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and other regions.To achieve high production and management
standards, we have obtained the certification of ISO22000 (including HACCP) in 2008, Halal
certification in 2009, and BRC(British Retail Consortium) certification in 2013, as well as passed
Export Commodity Inspection in 2009.

# Who We Are



────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**SOLINO ** is a Lebanese – Based company that manufacturers pellet for the Lebanese, Arab and      
International Market’s ready consumption, while simultaneously exporting raw pellet on demand to    
various factories worldwide.                                                                        
                                                                                                    
SOLINO was founded in 1995 as small Potato Chips manufacturing company based in Ghazieh – a town in 
the Southern district of Lebanon. Despite being equipped with one manually – operated Potato Chips  
Line, SOLINO still managed to produce the most successful Potato chips’ trademark in the history of 
Lebanon “RINGO”. This trademark’s instant success surpassed its humble beginnings, and paved the way
to the establishment of SOLINO’s of two high-tech, state –of-the-art potato chips factories that are
equipped today’s most modern machineries. These factories meet the International standards for      
handling, storage, packing systems, and fully automated production lines that operated and          
distribute around the clock.                                                                        
                                                                                                    
SOLINO’s success as a Potato Chips’ manufacturing company encouraged it’s owners to launch a        
subsidiary company call LINFO in 2005, which caters to the production of various kinds of readymade 
pastries (Cakes, Muffins, Croissants) under the trade mark “LORA”.                                  
                                                                                                    
LORA’s success in the Lebanese, Arab and International markets mirrors its parent company’s other   
successes in the Potato Chips business.

its dual focus on agriculture and engineering. Its Agri Business Division provides year-round
process-grade potatoes through advanced storage solutions and a nationwide delivery network.

leveraging cutting-edge technology for products like potato chips, roasted nuts, and various puffed
snacks. With a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and strategic partnerships, the company
excels in delivering superior efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Known for bold flavors and crispy satisfaction, the brand serves everything from classic potato chips to cheese puffs and popcorn. With a rich heritage and a wide-reaching presence in stores and vending machines, Tom’s continues to make snack time irresistibly tasty. ## Top Tom’s Chips Snacks ### Tom’s Original Potato Chips This iconic potato chip offers the timeless salty crunch that built the Tom’s brand, whether you’re snacking solo or dipping with friends. [ Check Price ][4] ### Tom’s Vinegar & Salt Potato Chips A bold twist on the classic, these chips deliver a tangy vinegar punch layered over crunchy potato for a snack that stands out. [ Check Price ][5] ### Bugles Nacho Cheese (Corn Snack) With its signature horn shape and zesty nacho‑cheese coating, this corn snack under the Tom’s umbrella offers fun form and flavor in one bag. [ Check Price ][6] Snack lovers rejoice—Tom’s Chips Snacks delivers irresistible crunch and bold flavor across a variety of tasty categories. ## Potato Chips Tom’s potato chips are a classic favorite, offering a perfect balance of crunch and seasoning in flavors that appeal to every taste. ## Corn Chips Packed with robust flavor and a hearty texture, Tom’s corn chips make an ideal snack on their own or paired with dips. ## Tortilla Chips Crispy and golden, Tom’s tortilla chips are perfect for nachos, dips, or enjoying straight from the bag. ## Fries Tom’s snack fries provide a salty, crunchy bite that’s perfect for a quick snack or vending machine treat. ## Pork Skins With their bold, savory flavor and satisfying crunch, Tom’s pork skins deliver a snack experience unlike any other. ## Bugles Tom’s Bugles bring a fun, cone-shaped twist to snacking, with a light, airy crunch and addictive flavor. ## Reviews **Jessica Reynolds** – “I’ve been enjoying Tom’s potato chips for years, and they never disappoint. The classic salted flavor is perfectly balanced, and the chips are always crispy without being greasy. I especially love grabbing a bag for road trips—the texture and taste hold up well even after hours in the car.” **Michael Thompson** – “Tom’s tortilla chips have become my go-to snack for game nights. They’re thick enough to scoop up salsa and guacamole without breaking, and the flavor is just right—not too salty, not bland. The family loves that there are multiple flavor options, so everyone finds something they enjoy.” **Samantha Lee** – “I recently tried Tom’s Bugles, and I was instantly hooked. The cone shape is fun to eat, and the light crunch is perfect for munching while watching a movie. I also appreciate that they don’t leave my fingers overly greasy, making them a much cleaner snack than other options I’ve tried.” ## Tom’s Chips FAQ ### What flavors of Tom’s Chips are available? Tom’s Chips come in a wide range of flavors, including classic salted, vinegar & salt, BBQ, sour cream & onion, and specialty seasonal flavors depending on availability. ### Where can I buy Tom’s Chips Snacks? Tom’s products are widely available in grocery stores, convenience stores, vending machines, and online retailers across the United States. ### Are Tom’s Chips gluten-free? Some Tom’s products are gluten-free, such as certain potato and corn chips, but it’s best to check the packaging for specific dietary information. ### How long do Tom’s Chips stay fresh after opening? For optimal taste and crunch, chips should be consumed within a few days of opening. Storing them in an airtight container helps extend freshness. ### Does Tom’s Chips offer family-size or party-size bags? Yes, Tom’s produces both single-serve bags for vending and larger bags suitable for sharing at parties or gatherings. ## Max Attacks Snacks – Tom’s Bacon Cheddar Fries ﻿﻿ Copyright © 2026 - Tom’s Chips [1]: #main [2]: https://toms-chips.com/ [3]: https://toms-chips.com/ [4]: # [5]: # [6]: #

# Tom's Hot Fries Potato Chips Manufacturer

Ignite your taste buds with the legendary crunch of Tom’s Hot Fries, a spicy Southern staple that
has been perfecting the art of the snack since 1925. These bold corn and potato snacks deliver an
unmistakable heat fueled by paprika and garlic, making them a go-to favorite for those who crave a
serious kick. While you won’t find a standalone boutique for these fiery treats, San Antonio Snacks
ensures they stay stocked at your local H-E-B, Walmart, or corner convenience store. Every bag packs
a punch of flavor and tradition, proving why this Georgia-born brand remains a powerhouse in the
world of savory, cholesterol-free snacking. Whether you are grabbing a quick bag from a vending
machine or stocking up for a road trip, Tom’s Hot Fries continue to define the gold standard for big
crunch and bold seasoning.

[ Learn More ][4]

## Top Tom's Hot Fries Potato Chips

### Tom's Snacks Hot Fries

These signature corn and potato sticks are famously dusted with a fiery blend of spices and paprika
to deliver an intense, crackling crunch in every bite.

[ Check Price ][5]

### Tom's Snacks Salt & Vinegar Potato Chips

Known for their sharp and revitalizing zest, these chips offer a perfectly balanced tang that
complements the natural savory flavor of premium sliced potatoes.

[ Check Price ][6]

### Tom's Snacks BBQ Corn Chips

A favorite for those who prefer a heartier texture, these robust corn chips are infused with a smoky
and sweet barbecue seasoning that stands up to any dip.

[ Check Price ][7]

Step into a world of bold seasonings and satisfying crunches with a snack lineup designed to fuel
your most flavorful cravings.


## Savory Snack Varieties

Tom’s Snacks delivers a diverse portfolio of textures and tastes that range from fiery heat to
classic salty perfection.

### Hot Fries

These signature snacks blend degermed yellow corn meal and dehydrated potatoes to create a uniquely
spicy, high-crunch experience.

### Original Potato Chips

This classic offering provides a timeless, golden-fried crunch finished with just the right amount
of salt.

### Vinegar & Salt Potato Chips

These chips deliver a sharp, tangy zest that perfectly balances acidity with a savory potato base.

### Corn Chips

Built for robustness, these chips offer a deep corn flavor and a sturdy texture that makes them
ideal for dipping.

### Tortilla Chips

Crafted for maximum crispiness, these chips serve as the perfect foundation for nachos or your
favorite salsa.

## Customer Experiences

**Marcus Holloway** I’ve been a loyal fan of Tom’s Hot Fries for years, and nothing else on the
market quite captures that specific blend of corn and potato texture. The seasoning is intense
without being overwhelming, and I love how the heat builds up gradually while I’m watching a game.
Every bag I open at the local Kroger is consistently fresh, and that signature red dust is basically
a badge of honor for snack lovers like me.

**Sarah Jenkins** Growing up in the South, Tom’s Original Potato Chips were a staple at every family
barbecue because they have that authentic, old-school crunch that modern brands can’t seem to
replicate. I recently tried the Vinegar & Salt variety for a road trip, and the tanginess was so
sharp and refreshing that the bag was gone before we even hit the state line. It’s hard to find a
snack that is both cholesterol-free and genuinely satisfying, but Tom’s manages to pull it off every
time.

**David Ramirez** I primarily handle the vending stocking for our office, and the Tom’s Corn Chips
are consistently the first item to sell out because they are so much heartier than the thin chips
you get elsewhere. I personally grab the Tortilla Chips for my weekend nachos because they are
sturdy enough to hold a ton of cheese and jalapeños without breaking. The bold seasoning profiles
across the entire Tom’s Snacks line make them stand out in a crowded aisle of bland options.

## Tom's Hot Fries FAQ

### What makes Tom’s Hot Fries different from other spicy snacks?

Tom’s Hot Fries feature a unique hybrid base of degermed yellow corn meal and dehydrated potatoes,
giving them a distinct “stick” shape and a crunch that is lighter than a standard corn chip but
sturdier than a potato chip. The flavor profile is defined by a bold blend of paprika, onion powder,
and garlic powder, providing a savory heat that builds gradually rather than overwhelming the palate
instantly.

### Where can I buy Tom’s Snacks products?

While there are no standalone Tom’s retail stores, our products are widely distributed through major
grocery chains and convenience stores across the United States. You can commonly find them at
retailers such as H-E-B, Walmart, Kroger, Fry’s Food Stores, and Rouses Markets, as well as in
vending machines serviced by our distribution partners.

### Are Tom’s Hot Fries gluten-free or kosher?

Tom’s Hot Fries are certified K

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

# 02. WHO WE ARE

We are Utz. Our story began with Bill and Salie who started making and selling potato chips in 1921.

**This is a reflection of Utz quality…in our facilities, in our products and in our people.
Together, the Utz team has provided the very best products to an ever growing marketplace since our
start.**

At Utz we know the secret to snack perfection, so we hand select from the finest products available
to personally pack your order, guaranteeing its fresh arrival. Whether you need one item or 1,000 –
we can help you or someone else enjoy Utz-standingly delicious gifts for any occasion. We hope you
enjoy our Snack Super Store filled with our growing family of snack brands!

## 05. WORK WITH UTZ

### Utz Careers

Join a Family Legacy

Here at Utz, our goal is to manufacture and sell the best possible products with a commitment to
customer satisfaction that is second to none. We pride ourselves on our pleasant working
environment, challenging opportunities, career growth and competitive wages. We also offer an
attractive benefit package that includes medical, prescription, dental and vision plans, an employer
match 401k, profit sharing plan and more. Come grow with the Utz Family of Brands!

[Click to Apply][117]

### Become a Distributor

Be Your Own Boss

Owning a Utz Route can be a personal and financially rewarding experience. Like Bill and Sallie, who
captured and thrived on an entrepreneurial spirit, we invite you to explore the avenues for success
that may be available to you as an Utz Independent Operator.

[Click to Learn More][118]

practices and ensuring that we are in full compliance with our legal obligations, we endeavour to
hold ourselves to the standards set by the United Nations.

Our colleagues are the driving force behind our success. With every snack that is fried, jelly
formed, wafer baked, or honey packed, we ensure that we are producing safely, responsibly and with
pride. We hold our business to the highest manufacturing standards.
